meta.comment: engine.season (MOD-027, §9/§17) month-index convention and curve inventory. This file is the sole source for every seasonal multiplier/weight engine.season's SeasonAPI exposes — GR#15: no seasonal figure lives as a Go literal in internal/engine/season/*.go outside doc-comment prose transcribing this file's own values.
meta.monthIndexConvention: Every curve's "multipliers" array has exactly 12 entries, index 0 = January ... index 11 = December (matches foundation/data.MonthlyCurve's own doc comment). engine.season's SeasonAPI takes an absolute month index matching engine.core's Clock.Month() (§3: int64, 0 = world genesis month, monotonically increasing, never resets) and maps it to a calendar-month position via monthIndex mod 12 — i.e. genesis month (index 0) is treated as January. This mapping is an engine.season assumption (ASM-, see BOW MOD-027) since §3/engine.core do not themselves pin which real calendar month world genesis falls in; it is recorded here, in one place, rather than left implicit in code.
meta.curveShapeConvention: electricityWinterPeak/waterSummerPeak/gasSeasonal step at month boundaries (flat between the §17.1-stated anchor months) rather than interpolating smoothly — a deliberate v1 choice (AC-4), not an oversight; smooth interpolation is a candidate M2 Batch tuning improvement, not a Sprint-3 requirement. The five curves without a spec-stated number (harvestCalendar, constructionSpeedMultiplier, schoolIntakeGate, leisureBeachWeight/leisureIndoorWeight, healthWaveModifier) are plausible v1 defaults establishing the right shape and direction only — exact magnitudes are pending M2 Batch tuning per the sprint-plan roadmap (see docs/planning/acceptance/engine.season.md's Out of scope section).

electricityWinterPeak.comment: §17.1: electricity 'winter +15%' — flat baseline with a December-February bump. Deliberately stepped, not smoothly interpolated (see meta.curveShapeConvention) — an M2 Batch tuning candidate, not a Sprint-3 gap.

waterSummerPeak.comment: §17.1: water '+25% summer peak' — flat baseline with a June-August bump. Deliberately stepped, not smoothly interpolated (see meta.curveShapeConvention) — an M2 Batch tuning candidate, not a Sprint-3 gap.

gasSeasonal.comment: §17.1: gas 'strongly seasonal: x2.2 Jan, x0.2 Jul' — only the two spec-stated anchor months are non-baseline. Deliberately stepped, not smoothly interpolated (see meta.curveShapeConvention) — an M2 Batch tuning candidate, not a Sprint-3 gap.

harvestCalendar.comment: §9: 'harvest calendar (local staples arrive in lumps -> storage strategy)'. No spec-stated magnitude (see engine.season.md's Escalations/For Bill note) — a plausible v1 UK-harvest-season lump (Aug/Sep peak, low the rest of the year), pending M2 Batch tuning. Per-crop-category detail belongs to engine.farming (out of scope here); this is a generic staples-arrival weighting.

constructionSpeedMultiplier.comment: §9: 'construction speed (winter slowdown)'. No spec-stated magnitude — a plausible v1 winter slowdown (Dec/Jan/Feb below 1.0x, ramping back up through spring), pending M2 Batch tuning.

schoolIntakeGate.comment: §9: 'school year (September intake gates)'. A gate curve, not a multiplier: 1.0 at exactly the calendar month that is September under this file's monthIndexConvention (index 8, 0=Jan), 0.0 every other month. engine.season.IsSchoolIntakeMonth reads which month is 'on' from this data rather than hardcoding month 8/September in Go (GR#15) — moving the intake month is a data edit here, not a code change. The 'exactly one month >= threshold' shape is enforced at Load time (MET-E504, BUG-059) — a curve with zero or two-or-more qualifying months fails to load rather than silently never firing or double-firing the intake gate.

leisureBeachWeight.comment: §9/§41: 'leisure mix (beach summer / indoor winter)', outdoor/beach half of the pair. No spec-stated magnitude — a plausible v1 summer-weighted curve (peak Jun-Aug), pending M2 Batch tuning. Paired with leisureIndoorWeight below; consumed together via SeasonAPI.LeisureMix.

leisureIndoorWeight.comment: §9/§41: 'leisure mix (beach summer / indoor winter)', indoor half of the pair. No spec-stated magnitude — a plausible v1 winter-weighted curve (peak Nov-Jan), pending M2 Batch tuning. Not required to sum to 1.0 with leisureBeachWeight (both are independent weights, not a normalised distribution) — a v1 design choice left for engine.cafe/leisure-venue demand to combine as that module sees fit.

healthWaveModifier.comment: §9/§18: 'minor health wave (winter)'. Stored as a non-negative severity (foundation/data.Seasonal.Validate rejects negative multipliers for every curve, by schema design — not a curve-specific choice this file can override): 0.0 = no wave, higher = worse. No spec-stated magnitude — a plausible v1 winter severity (Dec/Jan/Feb strongest, Mar/Nov a lesser shoulder, 0.0 the rest of the year), pending M2 Batch tuning. engine.season.HealthWaveModifier negates this value before returning it, so callers see the '(minor) negative adjustment to physical-health drift' the spec describes — see season.go's doc comment on that method.
